import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
sub = df[df['account_id']=='49tAGZz'].copy()
sub['date'] = pd.to_datetime(sub['date'], format='%m/%d/%Y')
before = sub[sub['date'] < '2025-10-13'].groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family'])['unblended_cost'].mean()
after = sub[sub['date'] >= '2025-10-13'].groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family'])['unblended_cost'].mean()
comp = pd.concat([before, after], axis=1)
comp['delta'] = comp.iloc[:,1] - comp.iloc[:,0]
print(comp[abs(comp['delta'])>0.01])

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
sub = df[df['account_id']=='49tAGZz'].copy()
sub['date'] = pd.to_datetime(sub['date'], format='%m/%d/%Y')
mask = (sub['csp']=='GCP')&(sub['cloud_service']=='Sj2f9')&(sub['application']=='9fC')&(sub['instance_family']=='G1QV542nCO')
print(sub[mask].groupby('date')[['price','num_instances','unblended_cost']].first())
